title: cerastium purpurascens subsp. parviflorum
intro: Cerastium purpurascens subsp. parviflorum, commonly known as a type of flowering plant, is a subspecies of Cerastium purpurascens. It is a type of herbaceous perennial plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including gastrointestinal problems and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cerastium purpurascens subsp. parviflorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-histaminic effects.
